findings.now: After iboga, wait a day if it was a low dose and usually a few days otherwise, and after a flood dose (one big dose) people often wait weeks before taking anything psychoactive, mainly so they don't block the after-effects they took iboga for.
findings.why: "a few days otherwise" seems to cover every dose that isn't low, and then a flood dose gets "weeks", so the reader has to reread to see that there are three cases and can't tell which doses the middle one covers.
where: The 5-HTP section: the interaction paragraph, P1

findings.now: While you're microdosing iboga, leave 5-HTP out altogether.
findings.why: The sentence before says to wait only a day after a low dose of iboga, and a microdose is a low dose, so a reader may not see why one gets "wait a day" and the other "leave it out altogether" (nothing says it's because microdosing is daily).
